Approved by the user 2026-11-17 (relayed by JSON: "yes. cheap try.").

lib/json.fz: the grammar scan computes nothing; the value comes from String.to_integer(token) once; a rescue of ArithmeticError around the number produces today's {:error, {:sequence, start, token}}, so error output is unchanged. integer_step and the `integer | :overflow` union are deleted.

Signal: MDF's sizing of the boxed accumulator, up to 2.6% of distiller cycles (bench); experiment with a plain integer accumulator: -4.2% instructions, young allocation -9%, live bytes equal. Rule: output identical, cycles measured, live bytes not raised. Its memory clause is judged on fz-9x7.30 (the experiment's ~500 MB in_use gap was that ticket's major to-space defect).
